title: Goblin Sledder — Doesn't correctly get +1/+1 until the end of turn when sacrificing Mogg War Marshall
scope: Goblin Sledder activated ability (Sacrifice a Goblin: target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn) with Mogg War Marshal as the sacrificed Goblin, plus a plain-token control; native engine, P0 + P1 human driver seats, protocol-98 driver
result: A1 setup passed (P0 PreCombatMain holding priority, Sledder + Mogg War Marshal + ETB Goblin token on P0's board, P1 Memnite on board, life 20/20). Leg 1: Sledder activation offered, targeted the Sledder, sacrificed the Marshal (mid1 stack depth 2: dies trigger + pump); the Marshal's dies trigger created a 1/1 red Goblin token and the Sledder went 1/1 -> 2/2 (A4 passed). Leg 2 control: sacrificing a plain Goblin token pumped the Sledder 2/2 -> 3/3 (A6 passed). Zero rejections. The reported 'doesn't correctly get +1/+1 when sacrificing Mogg War Marshal' does NOT reproduce on v0.99.0.

limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human driver seats.
Dense threat playsets (8x) are a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
The 'until end of turn' duration was not verified to wear off at cleanup; only the P/T gain was asserted.

Echo was not exercised in this run by design: the Marshal was sacrificed the same main phase it was cast, before any upkeep. A separate run confirmed the engine DOES implement Echo via UnlessPayment {1}{R} (observed 2026-10-01), so the reporter's echo theory is testable but the pump works regardless.
States are authoritative exports, restorable only via full game replay (driver/scenario_7344.py), not direct load.
Not tested on the report's original build (Discord report, 2026-08-13); verdict scoped to v0.99.0, not a fix claim.
driver_notes: Protocol-98 driver: MulliganDecision {"choice":{"type":"Keep"}} gated on pending[] Declare; BottomCards via single SelectCards; both seats driven (no AI).

Target vs sacrifice prompt disambiguation: P1 controls a Memnite (not a Goblin); a vi opportunity referencing the Memnite is the Pump's target prompt, one referencing only P0 Goblins is the sacrifice prompt. Holds regardless of prompt order.

Interaction response types must mirror the spec variant: 'sequence' -> {"type":"sequence","data":{"choiceIds":[...]}}, 'select' -> {"type":"select","data":{"choiceIds":[...]}}; submitting 'choose' for a 'select' spec is rejected invalid_interaction_response (caught on the first 7344 attempt).
Sacrificed tokens cease to exist instead of hitting the graveyard; sac_done accepts object-gone as paid.
A rejected interaction submission clears the optimistic prompt flags so the driver re-answers the still-pending prompt.

Marshal casting is gated on the Sledder already being on the battlefield so leg 1 fires the same main phase, before Echo (UnlessPayment {1}{R}) can trigger at the next upkeep. An UnlessPayment handler (pay when 2+ untapped Mountains, else decline) is kept as a safety net.
